notes.title: Demo Updated for Next Fest — Come Try It Out!
notes.content:
For Steam Next Fest, we’ve dropped a demo update. Here’s what’s new:

 Controls: Fixed keyboard support + added full mouse support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/790c741d8a97ef23339d01cc77abdce757e963e7.jpg
 Gamepad: Added a loading screen hint: «Use your gamepad, Ranger!»

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/acf650c8ffac51d67967273184b9fb17ae13df94.gif
 Level Design: Added a signpost to elevator rooms in the hub; polished tricky spots in some areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/bba569a947e7d7112c133ae892701f1b60d17ce2.gif
 Balance: Tweaked stats for certain items.
 Bugs: What bugs? Squashed a bunch of small issues!

Final Sprint: All hands on deck for Next Fest and our launch later this year. We’ll post more often—share your thoughts and questions! Talking with you matters.

Your turn:  Jump into the new demo and test it out! We need your feedback to make Rusty Rangers even better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/825938d74a387c6d9ea8c7e593bf9124a2265e93.png

notes.title: Demo updated
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684235/3472b8959ef1b24bf1205b25dd1bb8ba6f5813d0.png

We are pleased to present you a new update for the demo version of Rusty Rangers!

List of changes:
- updated tutorial
- updated UX/UI layouts
- added new sounds
- fixed bugs

We really hope you enjoy it. Have a good game!
